key_insight: An AI-assisted pipeline improves evaluation of research-level mathematical proofs across natural language, CAS code, and Lean formalizations.
engineering_relevance: Multi-format proof evaluation could support more reliable benchmarking of AI mathematics systems and validation workflows in AI for science.
method: Analyze Ramanujan Challenge submissions on research-level number theory problems.
Assess semantic and logical correctness across natural language proofs, CAS code, and Lean formalizations.
Compare pipeline judgments with conventional one-shot LLM judgments.
evidence_signal: The pipeline reduced false-positive verdicts on natural language proofs from 23% to 6% and increased judgment accuracy on supporting code from 46% to 58%.
watch_item: Residual errors remain substantial, especially for supporting code; the abstract does not establish generalization beyond this challenge.
paper_title: Ramanujan Challenge Results: AI-Assisted Evaluation Pipeline for Multi-Format Proofs
